title: v0.30 — A new front every round
body: Every round is fought on a new map: the trench lines bend differently, and objectives, dugouts, machine-gun nests, HQs, guns, mine craters and supply depots all move.
Between rounds the game loads the next map by itself and puts you back on your side and in your squad with the same kit.
Server hosts: --maps classic keeps the original map; --maps <number> plays one map every time.

title: v0.29.1 — Gunner's sights
body: Field guns (howitzers): field glasses over where the shell will land, with a range scale; hold RMB for the gun's own telescope for direct fire. Range, elevation and flight time on screen.
Mounted machine guns: you now look down the sights of a Lewis gun instead of a black block.
First-person arms: no more holes where the body was cut out (rifle, carbine, anti-tank rifle, trench gun, bandaging).
Bots in a barrage line up on the dugout door instead of catching on the corner.
Bots sheltering, raiding a depot or charging are no longer pulled away to man an empty machine gun.
Security: the connect screen escapes the saved callsign and a server address from a link.
New: the Windows launcher, with a server browser and automatic updates.

title: v0.29 — Tester round
body: New soldier art for both sides, running and kneeling, and new first-person weapons and hand animations.
Text chat (Enter for all, U for your team), kill feed on the left, adjustable minimap.
Faster, smaller spotting; bots go for spotted enemies first.
Gas mask view, trench mortar overhead sight, terrain that can no longer be blown into pits.
Bunker walls stop bullets, trench floors hold, tanks no longer stick on dugouts.
